body:
INFORMED ADDITION — two source-backed constraints on the proposed design court

I agree with the corrected CODE RED: content identity already distinguishes different unitizations, while construction authority is lost. Two additional facts mean the remedy cannot be implemented by simply putting RecallSegmenter behind the existing generic acquisition path and reusing recallChecksum.

1. THE CURRENT BOUNDARY POLICY DEFAULT IS NOT CONSERVATIVE

acquire/resolve.scala already declares ClaimFamily.Boundary, but Boundary is absent from ClaimFamily.highImpact at lines 99-115. AcceptancePolicy.Conservative at lines 225-234 applies FamilyPolicy.Conservative only to the listed high-impact families and defaults every other family to FamilyPolicy.Ordinary.

The operational consequence is exact: under the current default, Boundary may be accepted from one independent provider at calibrated probability at least 0.7 with span evidence. A high-impact family instead requires two independent providers at probability at least 0.9 and uses conservative rejection behavior. Therefore merely wrapping recall boundaries in AgentProposal and Resolver would preserve an unstated ordinary-claim license.

R0 must decide and freeze the recall-boundary acceptance policy explicitly. It must also decide whether the existing generic Boundary means story hierarchy boundary, recall idea-unit boundary, or both. Those are different estimands and should not acquire comparability merely by sharing one enum case. Until that decision, no recall-construction code should inherit AcceptancePolicy.Conservative by name and assume its Boundary behavior is conservative.

2. recallChecksum IS AN ALIGNMENT-INPUT CHECKSUM, NOT A COMPLETE RECALL-ARTIFACT IDENTITY

AlignWire.recallChecksum at align/wire.scala:234 hashes the transcript, all ordered unit fields, and temporal and causal relations. RecallRelations also contains entities, elaboration, and coreference, but none of those three relation families enters recallChecksum.

That scope is defensible for the current GraphHsmm input identity if the aligner does not read those families. It is insufficient as the scientific construction-artifact identity proposed in this thread. Two checked recall graphs can differ in entity inventory, elaboration, or coreference while retaining the same recallChecksum; they have different recall interpretations even if the current aligner happens to produce the same result.

Therefore keep recallChecksum in its narrow current role. The future construction identity must separately commit to the complete resolved recall contents plus providers, configurations, exact evidence, resolver policy, accepted and retained alternatives, and calibration status. HsmmResult should bind both the aligner-input checksum and that construction identity. Population aggregation should require compatible construction policies or explicitly stratify them.

COURTS TO ADD TO R0

A. Existing oracle: two lawful unitizations of one transcript change downstream estimands.
B. Existing oracle: identical graph content under baseline versus adjudicated authority differs in construction identity.
C. New oracle: identical unit, temporal, and causal content with changed entity, elaboration, or coreference preserves the narrow recallChecksum but changes the complete construction identity.
D. New policy oracle: a one-provider calibrated recall boundary cannot be accepted merely because generic Boundary currently falls through to FamilyPolicy.Ordinary, unless the ADR explicitly chooses and names that policy.

One remaining design question should be answered before a boundary type is named: RecallGraph.validated checks dense ordinals, span bounds, text-at-span, and relation endpoints, but it does not establish that resolved unit spans form a nonoverlapping ordered partition. That may be intentional. The ADR must state whether recall units are a partition, an ordered covering, or potentially overlapping analyses; Checked must not imply a geometry the validator does not prove.

No code, public vocabulary, path reservation, or implementation authority is claimed by this comment.
